text:
elaine_sales: Heads-up: Prospect Meridian wants a short perf validation for their checkout chat. Goals: sustain 250 qps, survive 3 microbursts ~20s at 700 qps, target p95 <200ms. Need runbook + hosted vs dedicated cost delta.
omar_se: Got it. Do we have avg tokens and model?
jin_perf: They sent sample set: ~60 prompt, ~150 reply -> ~210 tokens. Model: open-70b quant-8. Mix ~70% chat, 30% long completions.
omar_se: Test plan proposal: warmup 5m @30% load; steady 30m @250 qps; burst matrix 3x [450, 700, 700] qps 20s each; cross-AZ 10% fallback 10m.
jin_perf: Prewarm: prime 1.5k prefixes + 10m low qps fill. Measure p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, avg batch size, GPU util, queue depth. Sample traces 0.5%.
morgan_ops: Sizing: with KV caching + batching, 250 sustained ~5 A100-equiv GPUs; for 700 qps bursts keep 8 GPUs or autoscale rapid. Hosted cost multiplier ~1.8x. Autoscale cooldown 60s.
tara_sec: Security asks: SAML SSO, KMS for key management, audit logs 90d. If they want to test with live PII need signed DPA + KMS exchange.
elainE_sales: (typo)
elaine_sales: Can we sketch a monthly baseline for 1M req/mo (avg 210 tokens)? I just need a ballpark.
morgan_ops: Ballpark: Hosted inference-only ~$4k/mo; small Dedicated commit amortized ~$2.6-3k/mo plus ops. We'll refine post-run.
jin_perf: Loadgen snippet:
```
wrk -t12 -c380 -d20s -R700 --script=chat_mix.lua --latency $TARGET
```
Steady-state run: -R250 for 30m. Include our x-rw-trace header.
runbot: perf job #801 queued: container build OK.
jin_perf: Dry-run quick: steady 250 qps -> p95 185ms, p99 420ms. 700 qps bursts -> p95 peaks ~520ms, p99 ~1.1s. KV off -> p95 +30%. GPU util ~80% steady, ~99% bursts. Raw logs -> secure link.
omar_se: Good. Action items: 1) elaine upload corpus (EOD). 2) morgan provision cluster (done). 3) jin run dry-run and post slides. 4) tara prepare security checklist.
elaine_sales: Uploading corpus now and will confirm DPA path. Booking customer demo Friday 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:
